rules.reason: 3,132 sessionStart values have the shape 99/99/9999 99:99, a day-first UK date and time, while the other 46,848 are already ISO UTC.
3,132 dateOfBirth values have the shape 99/99/9999, a day-first UK date, while the rest are already ISO.
Postcodes appear in lower case (a99 9a, a9 9a), with double spaces (A99  9A) or with no space (A999A, A99A), all of which this normalises.
Many first names are entirely lower case (shape a, 376) or all upper case (shape A, 567), which title case fixes.
Some last names are entirely upper case (shape A, 529) or lower case (shape a, 348), which title case fixes.
Guardian phones appear in mixed forms such as 99999 999999, 99999999999 and +99 9999 999999 that should be put in international form.
